text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A lot of strong older racers are running in the Takarazuka Kinen. Mejiro McQueen, for one.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer and Ikuno Dictus are running too. They're all so mature and cool. It'll take a lot of courage for me to join their ranks…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But Trainer's given me all the courage I need, so I'm sure I'll be fine!
